name: SupermarketShoppingSoloListReader

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating a realistic near-future solo supermarket conversation — one person, talking to Sigma to track what's left on the list. Using Sigma for this is completely normal.

Write dialogue that sounds like a real person checking in with a practical assistant. Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters. Split longer thoughts.
- The list check happens at least 4 times — it's the recurring beat
- Each exchange is short: Grace asks, Sigma answers, Grace briefly reacts or moves on
- No internal monologue turns — every Grace turn either asks Sigma something or reacts to Sigma's last answer
- Sigma answers list queries in one sentence

sound_effects_config.prompt: Supermarket ambience, background store music, shopping basket, quiet aisle, refrigerator hum

initial_prompt:
Generate a solo shopping conversation where Grace uses Sigma to track her list as she moves through the store. She asks 'what's left?' at least four times across the shop, at natural intervals. At one point she's uncertain whether she already picked something up and asks Sigma to confirm. She also asks one non-list food question. Between list checks she may say a brief word before the next question — but no standalone thinking-aloud turns. Every Grace turn is either a question to Sigma or a short reaction before the next question.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Grace is the only human voice — Sigma is the only other
- No solo monologue turns — Grace always either asks or reacts briefly then asks
- List checks feel natural, not mechanical
- One non-list question to Sigma during the shop

variations.context: Solo weekly shop — using Sigma to track the list, checking in between sections

setting.mood: Efficient and calm. One of the peaceful parts of the week.
setting.background: After a busy work week. Saturday morning. She knows this shop well.
setting.conversation_style: Short Q&A check-ins. Grace asks, Sigma answers, Grace acts.

scenario_template.topic: First check as she enters — what's on the list?
scenario_template.note: Sigma gives the list overview. Grace sets off.

scenario_template.topic: After the first section — what's left?
scenario_template.note: Sigma confirms remaining items. Grace may say one brief word before asking.

scenario_template.topic: Did she already pick something up? She can't remember.
scenario_template.note: Sigma confirms whether the item is ticked. She proceeds.

scenario_template.topic: A quick food question — storage, nutrition, substitution
scenario_template.note: One specific question. Sigma answers briefly. She acts on it.
A few items left. Sigma names them.

scenario_template.topic: Finding an item in a new spot
scenario_template.note: Grace asks Sigma where an item has moved to. Sigma guides her.
Grace shares a cooking tip she recalls from her grandmother. Sigma listens and acknowledges.

scenario_template.topic: Brief chat with a store employee
scenario_template.note: Grace exchanges a few words with a friendly employee about a product.

scenario_template.topic: Spotting a new product for later
scenario_template.note: Grace sees a new product and asks Sigma to add it to her wishlist.
Grace checks which brand is cheaper for a staple item. Sigma provides price details.

scenario_template.topic: Quick meal prep idea based on cart contents
scenario_template.note: After noticing ingredients in her cart, Grace asks Sigma for a quick recipe suggestion.
Sigma confirms. Grace heads to checkout.

user1.name: Grace
user1.role: Solo shopper. Efficient and self-aware. Uses Sigma to track the list and occasionally for a food question. Asks, reacts briefly, moves on.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: List tracker. Answers 'what's left', 'have I got X', and one food question. Consistent across the shop.
